answer: The delta counter is kept in glacier and ember shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 42 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. An copycat therefore has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 42 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 3262 identities would post 4351 proofs and burn roughly 44 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
